strategies.overview: Alolan Diglett is an excellent wallbreaker and late-game cleaner in Little Cup, with a blazing Speed tier and dangerous STAB combination. With solid coverage and the power boost from Life Orb, Alolan Diglett can OHKO or 2HKO most of the tier. Despite its strengths, Alolan Diglett is very frail, making it difficult to get onto the field without support and means it is also susceptible to priority moves.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Alolan Diglett can use Swords Dance to be near unstoppable after a boost, but it is unreliable due to Alolan Diglett's fragility leaving few opportunities to set up. Tera Blast Flying deals heavy damage to Mienfoo and Foongus and OHKOs the two if they lost their Eviolite as well as OHKOing Toedscool from full health with Eviolite, but other Tera types are often more useful. Alolan Diglett can be used as a lead on hyper offense teams with a Focus Sash to set Stealth Rock and faint with Memento for a teammate to set up.

Checks and Counters

Choice Scarf Pokemon: Choice Scarf users such as Hisuian Growlithe and Mienfoo can outspeed and revenge kill Alolan Diglett.

Grookey: Grookey's Grassy Terrain halves the power of Earthquake and lets it threaten Alolan Diglett with priority Grassy Glide.

Bulky Pokemon: Pokemon like Mienfoo, Foongus, and Mudbray can take a hit from Alolan Diglett if they are healthy enough and threaten it back.

movesets.name: Life Orb
movesets.description:
Earthquake threatens OHKOs on Pokemon such as Glimmet, Tinkatink, and Chinchou. Rock Blast threatens the Flying-types that otherwise would give Alolan Diglett trouble, notably Vullaby due to the interaction with Weak Armor. Sucker Punch helps Alolan Diglett pick off weakened foes that Speed tie or outspeed it, such as Wingull and Hisuian Growlithe. Iron Head lets Alolan Diglett almost always 2HKO Toedscool and Grookey, with the added flinch chance helping against bulky Pokemon like Mienfoo. Alternatively, Substitute can be used to scout for Terastallizations, switches, and Sucker Punch from Stunky and opposing Alolan Diglett. Alolan Diglett has many viable Tera types available to it: Tera Ground boosts the damage of Earthquake, KOing most neutral targets such as Mienfoo and Foongus after some chip damage, Tera Dark powers up Sucker Punch while giving Alolan Diglett a resistance to opposing Sucker Punch users like the aforementioned Stunky, and Tera Stellar provides a small boost to all of Alolan Diglett's attacks, which can allow it to pick up some surprise KOs.

Alolan Diglett's high Speed and damage output make it a perfect fit on offensive structures. Pivot support is vital for Alolan Diglett to safely get onto the field, which can be provided by U-turn from Mienfoo and Vullaby and Volt Switch from Elekid and Chinchou. Teammates like Vullaby, Stunky, and Tinkatink can remove Eviolite from Pokemon that are usually able to take a hit from Alolan Diglett such as Mienfoo and Mudbray are appreciated.
